text:
anna-support: Heads up: Acme raised an erasure request for EU user data (prompts + embeddings) but their counsel also sent a hold notice asking us to preserve the same scope for 90 days. Need guidance on whether we pause or proceed and what evidence package we can produce.

luis-eng: Quick clarifying q's — are they on Hosted or Dedicated? Which region/tenant? What stores (embeddings DB, request logs, cache, backups)? KMS/HSM details? :thinking:

anna-support: Hosted, region eu-west-1. Embeddings in our managed vector store (encrypted at rest), request logs in central analytics store, KV prefix cache in redis cluster, daily EBS snapshots retained 30 days. KMS: AWS KMS default (no external HSM). Customer wants a timestamped proof of deletion.

shweta-legal: Legal note: a legal hold can override erasure only if the customer provides a lawful hold notice we can rely on (court order/subpoena, etc.). Ask them to send the hold in writing with clear scope. Absent that, DPA erasure should be honored. We'll need an evidence package if they choose erasure.

sam-sre: I can assemble the evidence bundle. Items I can produce: CSV of audit events (CloudTrail + internal), cache invalidation logs, snapshot purge confirmations, KMS/CloudTrail slices showing key usage and access. ETA dependent on job queue.

sam-sre: Internal extraction snippets:
```
# audit export
internal_audit export --customer acme-corp --from 2025-01-01 --to 2025-03-01 --out /tmp/acme_audit.csv

# invalidate cache prefix
redis-cli -h redis-eu-01 --eval scripts/flush_prefix.lua acme:users:12345

# trigger snapshot purge for tenant-hosted
snapctl --tenant hosted --match "acme*" --retention 0 --exec --log /tmp/purge_acme.log
```

sam-sre: Notes: EBS snapshots may be copied to cold long-term archives by internal export jobs; we'll include retention metadata and any export-job ids. We cannot delete KMS Customer Master Keys immediately — we can show that ciphertext references were removed and provide CloudTrail records of key usage and policy changes.

infra-bot: Audit export job queued: export-job-1973602000-audit (ETA ~90m). KMS slice request queued: kms-slice-1973602050.

luis-eng: Draft customer-facing options to send: 1) Provide a signed legal-hold notice with exact scope — we'll pause erasure and provide preservation logs. 2) Confirm to proceed with erasure — we'll run sanitization and issue an evidence bundle with timeline, audit CSV, cache logs, snapshot purge IDs, and CloudTrail KMS events. Be explicit about residuals: live indexes and caches removed synchronously; snapshots purged per retention but we can accelerate within ops limits.

luis-eng: If they pick erasure I'll run an automated runbook that: identifies resources, runs prefix deletes, invalidates caches, purges snapshots, and compiles CloudTrail and audit slices into a signed PDF report. ETA for evidence bundle after confirmation: ~4 hours if infra queue is clear.

anna-support: Draft reply (sending to customer, cc legal & SRE):
"Hi — we need either (A) a formal legal-hold notice (written, signed) with precise scope (user IDs/org IDs/date ranges) or (B) your confirmation to proceed with the erasure. If you choose erasure we will run our sanitization procedure and return a time-stamped evidence bundle (audit CSV, CloudTrail KMS entries, cache invalidation logs, snapshot purge IDs). Please indicate which option you prefer and the exact scope. Also let us know if you require the evidence in a specific format (signed PDF)."

shweta-legal: LGTM. Add request to include the legal basis for the hold and contact for counsel if we need to validate.

anna-support: Sending now and CC'ing @shweta-legal and @sam-sre. :white_check_mark:

luis-eng: I'll prep the erasure runbook and one-click orchestration. Will post the runbook link once the export-job completes.

sam-sre: After confirmation I'll attach: /tmp/acme_evidence_bundle_{ts}.zip containing acme_audit.csv, kms_cloudtrail_slice.json, cache_invalidation.log, purge_acme.log, and a signed ops statement. We'll timestamp and include job ids.

anna-support: Customer replied (via support ticket): "We confirm erasure for user IDs [list] and waive the legal-hold. Please proceed and provide the evidence bundle. PDF preferred." Forwarding to legal/SRE now.

shweta-legal: Good. Proceed per runbook. Keep chain of custody in the PDF and note any items we couldn't remove (e.g., immutable archival exports) with their retention metadata.

sam-sre: Kicking off erasure workflow now. Job: erasure-job-1973604000. I'll update thread with bundle link when ready.

infra-bot: Erasure job started: erasure-job-1973604000. Progress logs available at https://infra.internal/jobs/1973604000/logs

sam-sre: Evidence bundle created: /artifacts/acme_evidence_bundle_1973604450.zip. Contents: acme_audit.csv, kms_slice_1973604400.json, cache_invalidation_1973604300.log, snapshot_purge_1973604330.log, ops_statement_signed.pdf.

anna-support: Uploaded bundle to ticket and notified customer. Closing loop with legal. :lock: Done.
